errors.description: duty_cycle_q is a multi-bit value produced in cfg_clk and sampled directly in pwm_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
commit_pulse_q is a one-cycle cfg_clk pulse consumed directly in pwm_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
commit_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample pwm_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in pwm_event_o.
period_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector period_mode_q before decoding in pwm_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
cfg_rst_n is used as data inside pwm_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
aon_snapshot_q combines cfg_clk payload state with pwm_clk status state in aon_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
